items.text: All four tunes are the trombonist's own, and the longest of them runs past twelve minutes.
items.why: Track listing: 'All compositions by Grachan Moncur III', four titles, '"Evolution" - 12:24' the longest; Lead: 'trombonist Grachan Moncur III'. Accurate but a weak hook that says little about the music.

items.text: 21 November 1963, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs
items.why: Infobox 'Recorded: November 21, 1963 Van Gelder Studio , Englewood Cliffs'.

items.text: Grachan Moncur III (trombone), Lee Morgan (trumpet), Jackie McLean (alto saxophone), Bobby Hutcherson (vibes), Bob Cranshaw (double bass), Tony Williams (drums)
items.why: Personnel lists exactly these six with these instruments.

items.text: Moncur and his compositions were featured on two Jackie McLean albums made for Blue Note in 1963.
items.why: Lead: 'Two McLean albums also recorded for Blue Note in 1963 ( One Step Beyond and Destination... Out!) featured Moncur and his compositions'.

items.text: Both records explored the same inside and outside approach to music.
items.why: Lead: 'and explored the same "inside/outside" musical approach.' In the pack 'the same' means the same as Evolution; the notes drop that referent, so it can read as the two McLean records matching each other. Vague rather than wrong.

missed: The sound: The Penguin Guide says 'the whole record has a dark, misterioso quality that the lowering trombone sound... strongly accentuates'. Also that this is Moncur's debut as a leader and is considered a significant contribution to the jazz avant-garde. listen_for is empty although the pack names all four tracks.
